# deps: tools: up octosql to v0.9.0

Pin `octosql` at v0.9.0 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-345]] (v0.8.1); the release notes are the [v0.9.0 tag](https://github.com/cube2222/octosql/releases/tag/v0.9.0). A change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod) ([[DOT-96]] for what OctoSQL is and why it was fragile).
